title: Stellarium Session Weekly Session Length Trend
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stellarium:session session_min=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(session_min) as avg_duration, max(session_min) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst session length for Stellarium session events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture session_min on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average session length with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It charts whether Stellarium session tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
